text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The Big Carrot Burger has come to
Japan!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Trainer! Fancy goin' for a burger
with me?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
They've brought over one of my favorite
burgers
from back home!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's outta this world! First, there's the
giant patty,
practically overflowin' with
juices...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Then comes the sweet, buttery carrot
sauce on
top! I used to buy 'em with my
family all the
time...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's why we gotta go together,
Trainer. 'Cause
you're my Japanese
family!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why we gotta go!
Munchin' on that
burger will give me the
strength to work hard!
Pleeease!
choice_data_list: You know we have training right af...
You know we have training right af...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yesss! All right, then—we'd better scoot!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much, Trainer! Don't hold
back, now!
Eat your fill!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And afterward,
let's give training our all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... I can't believe they're closed
today...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I swear I looked it up and everything... Boo.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We can get the burgers to go? I didn't
know that
was an option!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This way, we can avoid usin' up too much
training
time. Everything works out!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're just as smart as a whip, Trainer. I
tip my
hat to ya!
